printify.title: Sless After Dark — Halloween Tee
printify.description:
Sless Taylor perches above the ring in this original Sless After Dark Halloween illustration: a white cape, pumpkin lantern, orange moon, haunted houses and purple clouds.

The shaped artwork has a transparent outer edge—not a square background panel. Choose Purple, Orange or Black in adult unisex sizes S–3XL. Printed on the front of a Gildan 5000 heavy cotton tee, with a classic fit and crew neckline.

Approximate artwork width: 6.75 inches. Made to order. Shipping is calculated at checkout for supported destinations. No guaranteed Halloween arrival date.
